name: Find Dorms by Criteria
description: Find dorm options that match a student's budget, location, and amenity preferences
prompt_template: Find UIUC dorm options that match these criteria: price range {{price_range}}, preferred location {{location}}, desired amenities {{amenities}}. Return the strongest matches with trade-offs.

price_range.description: Budget target or range such as low, mid, high, or a dollar range

location.description: Preferred campus area or proximity target

amenities.description: Comma-separated amenity preferences such as private bathroom, AC, dining hall
